description: Palettes and gradients you can copy into a design, each with a stated license.
description_zh: 可复制到设计中的配色与渐变，每项都注明许可证。

entries.name: Open Color
entries.description: 13-step colour scheme for interface work, shipped as CSS, Sass, Less and JSON.
entries.description_zh: 13 级界面配色方案，提供 CSS、Sass、Less 与 JSON 格式。

entries.name: Nord
entries.description: 16-colour arctic palette with ports for editors, terminals and design tools.
entries.description_zh: 16 色北极配色，提供编辑器、终端与设计工具的适配版本。

entries.name: Catppuccin
entries.description: Pastel palette in four flavours, with community ports for apps, editors and terminals.
entries.description_zh: 四种口味的柔和配色，社区提供应用、编辑器与终端的适配主题。

entries.name: Radix Colors
entries.description: 12-step colour scales with dark and alpha variants, for interfaces and charts.
entries.description_zh: 12 级色阶，含深色与透明变体，适用于界面与图表。

entries.name: WebGradients
entries.description: 180 linear gradients as CSS, with Sketch and PSD downloads.
entries.description_zh: 180 个线性渐变，提供 CSS 以及 Sketch、PSD 下载。
entries.notes: The site states free commercial use; the repository carries an MIT licence.
entries.notes_zh: 站点声明可免费商用；代码仓库采用 MIT 许可。

entries.name: uiGradients
entries.description: Gradient library with copyable CSS and SVG for each preset.
entries.description_zh: 渐变库，每个预设都提供可复制的 CSS 与 SVG。
